# ChoreStar

> ChoreStar is a family chore chart app for the web, iPhone, and iPad. Parents
> set up chores with reward amounts and step-by-step routines; kids sign in
> with a family code and a 4-digit PIN (no email address needed) and check off
> their own work. The app tracks allowance automatically, keeps streaks and
> badges, and pays out in real money the parent hands over. It never moves
> real money and never gives a child a debit card.

Key facts:
- Free plan: up to 3 children and 20 chores, kid PIN login, routines,
  achievement badges. Free forever, no card required.
- Premium: $4.99/month or $49.99/year. Unlimited children and chores, family
  sharing with a co-parent, premium themes, export reports.
- Platforms: web app at https://chorestar.app and a native iOS app for iPhone
  and iPad (App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6761279049). One account
  syncs both.
- Kid login uses a family code plus a per-child PIN. Children never provide an
  email address or personal information.
- Kid mode is localized in English, Spanish, Portuguese, and Arabic.
- Allowance modes: a reward per chore, or a flat daily rate, with an optional
  full-week bonus. Goals let a kid save toward something; a reward store
  prices things money cannot buy (screen time, picking dinner).
- Vacation mode pauses chores for a date range so streaks stay safe.
- Privacy: family data is never shared or sold. https://chorestar.app/privacy
